gate_or_program: CMP-01 — Bounded Shared-Brand Packet Composition / Interaction Audit
bounded_question: Can exact C0 Threshold K, MAT F1, STA F2, MOT F1A and MOT CS2 coexist on neutral synthetic APP/WEB carriers without identity competition, semantic collision, accessibility loss, or evidence that removing one included packet makes the composition materially stronger?

authority.current_state_at_close: CMP-01 canonical mechanical and subjective result frozen on the active post-MAT branch before promotion.

excluded_variables: real product semantics or shipping UI architecture

local_result.summary: PASS_COMPATIBLE_COMPOSITION. The exact five-packet set coexists on the frozen bounded APP/WEB carriers without a named collision; ablations confirm each packet’s intended contribution or non-destructive optionality.

judgment.design_sol_view: FULL retains clear hierarchy and a single primary identity carrier. MAT F1 adds authored carrier topology without overtaking C0/content; STA F2 preserves selected-state legibility alongside keyboard focus; F1A and CS2 remain semantically disjoint. No ablation is materially stronger because it removes a collision.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: No separate Director taste gate is triggered. The result advances under standing clean-recursive-audit delegation and remains explicitly non-final.
